questions.question: Paul told believers in Corinth not to take a complaint against another believer to unrighteous judges. Who should they bring it to instead?
Paul told the church in Corinth that believers will judge the world. Who else did he say they will judge?
Rather than suing each other, what did Paul say the Corinthian believers should be willing to do?

answers.text: Take it to a higher court
Ask Paul to come and decide

questions.question: Paul told the church in Corinth that some of them used to be wicked people. What did he say had happened to them?

answers.text: They were washed and made holy and right with God
They still have to earn their way back to God
They are no different from how they used to be
